model.name: File detail: buttons and preview first, metadata last
model.description: The in-room file detail view is reordered so action buttons (open-in-preview, open-in-new-tab) come first at the top, then a pan- and zoom-capable preview pane sized at 75% of screen height, then the metadata detail (name, size, type, scenario info) last - reversed from the current order where detail is on top and buttons/preview are at the bottom.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "the in room file details shall START with the action button and the preview pane, then the detail. reverse order. preview 75% screen size. preview needs to pan zoom its content."
model.architectureRef: ior:file:scrum.pmo/sprints/sprint-21-contact-identity/architecture.md#6-in-room-file-detail-reorder-pan-zoom (RbPanZoom transform gesture handler, reorder, correctness rules)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Action buttons (open-in-preview, open-in-new-tab) render at the TOP of the file detail view.
The preview pane renders BELOW the buttons at height 75vh with overflow:hidden.
Metadata (.dv-fields: name/size/type/scenario) renders BELOW the preview (last).
Order is reversed from the current layout (was: metadata top, preview+buttons bottom at 400px).
The 75vh preview pane is an in-flow block (NOT position:fixed) so it never intercepts taps outside its own box.
Pan/zoom is applied as CSS transform: translate(tx,ty) scale(s) with transform-origin:0 0 on .pz-content inside .pz-viewport.
scale is clamped to [1, 8] (MIN..MAX).
Zoom-about-a-point keeps the cursor/pinch-midpoint point stationary: tx'=px-f*(px-tx), ty'=py-f*(py-ty), f=newScale/oldScale.
tx,ty are clamped after every gesture so content cannot be dragged fully out of view; recenters when scale==1.
Mouse wheel zooms about the cursor position (offsetX/offsetY); the handler is passive:false and preventDefaults the wheel.
Mouse drag pans the content only when scale>1; cursor shows grab/grabbing.
One-finger drag pans when scale>1; when scale==1 it does NOT hijack page scroll.
Two-finger pinch zooms about the midpoint and pans by the midpoint delta.
Double-tap toggles reset (scale 1, tx/ty 0) <-> 2x zoom at the tap point.

The double-tap detector requires touchend with touches.length===0 AND a single-finger touchstart AND duration<250ms AND movement<10px AND gap<300ms — so a pinch release (two touchend, changedTouches.length===1 each) never misfires a reset.
Hit-testing during touch uses e.target, never document.elementFromPoint.
Gesture listeners are attached to the .pz-viewport element ONLY, not the detail/drawer root.
destroy() removes all listeners; on re-render (ViewBus) the old controller is torn down before a new one attaches (no leaked/stacked listeners).
While a gesture is active, an iframe preview gets pointer-events:none (re-enabled on idle) so drags pan instead of being swallowed by the iframe.
State resets to {scale:1, tx:0, ty:0} whenever the previewed file changes.
RbPanZoom is content-type agnostic — works for image (img), text (pre), and iframe content.
DRY: the same RbPanZoom is reused by the room file view and content-preview.ts (no duplicate gesture code).

testScenarios.name: reorder DOM emit order
testScenarios.given: a File unit opened in the in-room detail view
testScenarios.then: DOM order is [buttons row] -> [.pz-viewport height:75vh overflow:hidden, in-flow not fixed] -> [.dv-fields metadata]; reversed from prior layout

testScenarios.name: zoom about cursor keeps point stationary
testScenarios.when: wheel-zoom in over a content point (px,py)
testScenarios.then: transform = translate(tx,ty) scale(s) with the same content point still under (px,py); scale clamps at 8

testScenarios.name: pan clamp + recenter
testScenarios.when: the user pans far past an edge, then zooms back to scale 1
testScenarios.then: content is edge-stopped (never fully out of view) and recenters at scale==1

testScenarios.name: desktop wheel + drag
testScenarios.then: wheel zooms about cursor (event default prevented); drag pans only when scale>1 with grab cursor

testScenarios.name: one-finger pan vs page scroll
testScenarios.given: touch device, preview at scale 1 then scale 2
testScenarios.then: at scale 1 the page scrolls normally (no hijack); at scale 2 the content pans

testScenarios.name: pinch zoom about midpoint
testScenarios.given: touch device, two fingers on the preview
testScenarios.then: content zooms about the finger midpoint and pans by the midpoint delta

testScenarios.name: double-tap toggle + pinch-release guard
testScenarios.given: a preview and (a) a genuine double-tap, (b) a pinch release
testScenarios.then: (a) toggles reset<->2x at the tap point; (b) does NOT reset (pinch release with touches.length>0 / changedTouches===1 is rejected by the detector)

testScenarios.name: hit-test uses e.target
testScenarios.given: a touch where the DOM mutated mid-gesture
testScenarios.when: the handler resolves the touched element
testScenarios.then: it uses e.target (correct), not document.elementFromPoint (which would return a wrong node)

testScenarios.name: scoped listeners + teardown
testScenarios.given: a file detail that re-renders via ViewBus
testScenarios.then: listeners live only on .pz-viewport; each re-render calls destroy() first so listener count stays constant (no leak/stack), and taps elsewhere in the drawer are unaffected

testScenarios.name: iframe pointer-events during gesture
testScenarios.then: the iframe has pointer-events:none during the gesture (drag pans) and regains pointer-events when idle

testScenarios.name: reset on file change
testScenarios.when: a different file is opened in the same detail view
testScenarios.then: state resets to {scale:1,tx:0,ty:0} for the new content

testScenarios.name: content-agnostic + DRY reuse
testScenarios.given: image, text (pre), and iframe previews, and the room file view
testScenarios.then: the SAME RbPanZoom drives all three content types and is shared with the room file view (no duplicated gesture code)

model.refinementNote: R21.9 refined 2026-06-28 per PO directive (design deep-dive): detailed ACs (a:reorder, b:transform-model, c:desktop, d:touch, e:correctness, f:reuse) + 12 gateable test scenarios, grounded in architecture.md section 6 (RbPanZoom transform gesture handler). Correctness ACs (e1-e6) encode hard-won touch-gesture rules: double-tap requires touches.length===0 (pinch-release guard), e.target over elementFromPoint, viewport-scoped listeners, destroy() teardown, iframe pointer-events, reset-on-change. Chain (parent/owner/useCases) unchanged; name/description/tronQuote unchanged.
